characters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for an existing tactical RPG. Input image is CHARACTER IDENTITY AND PIXEL STYLE REFERENCE, not desired output layout. Preserve reference identity, proportions, face, outfit, species and colours precisely. No new equipment. CRITICAL OUTPUT: exactly SIX equal columns and EIGHT equal rows =48 separate poses, one complete character in each invisible equal square cell. Portrait canvas ratio3:4, suggested1536x2048. Truly transparent RGBA background. No labels, grid, scenery, ground or shadows. All standing frames same figure height, centered feet baseline at85%cell height; ample margins even for prone poses. Columns are animation time left to right. Row1 six-frame WALK front three-quarter facing RIGHT (left contact, down, passing, right contact, down, passing). Row2 same WALK RIGHT PROFILE. Row3 same WALK BACK three-quarter RIGHT. Row4 six-frame CAST front three-quarter RIGHT (prepare, gather, deep anticipation, clear extended-hand release, follow-through, recover). Row5 same CAST RIGHT PROFILE. Row6 same CAST BACK three-quarter RIGHT. Row7 six-frame IMPACT front three-quarter RIGHT (brace, hit, deep recoil, catch balance, recover, upright rest). Row8 six-frame DEFEAT front three-quarter RIGHT (stagger, knees buckle, fall onto side, ground contact, settle, still LYING DOWN). Final three defeat frames visibly on ground, not standing; no gore, fading or disintegration. Author distinct actual articulated anatomy: limbs bend, feet plant, shoulders and clothing overlap. Never copy and rigidly transform identical poses. Opposite legs/arms in walk. Consistent character scale throughout. Crisp polished pixel clusters, controlled palette, dark silhouette outline, warm-brass accents. HARD clean alpha edges; no ambient coloured fringe, floating particles, glow, blur, bloom, airbrush or isolated stray pixels. Forty-eight separated usable animation frames.
CHARACTER: Leaf the Hidden, a small-to-medium treefolk made of bark limbs, deep leaf-green hood with pointed top, dark hollow face with two glowing amber eyes, layered leafy cloak, warm brass belt and bark root feet. No staff.
UNIQUE PERFORMANCE: Patient short root steps; broad water-like open-hand arc with leafy sleeve follow-through; hit crouches protectively under hood; defeat knees fold and rests as a sideways leaf-cloaked body, face never becomes human.
Every cell including all prone frames has a minimum10% transparent side gutter. Preserve six equally-spaced character centres in every row, never merge neighbouring poses.
